spots.text: I have been down. There is a chair.

secrets.name: The Landing Door
secrets.text: Halfway down, where the lamps give up, a door in the pier was open all along. Someone sits up here with a candle so as not to have to go any further.

meta.label: The Black Stair
meta.blurb: A grand stair goes down from the lamps into a dark the lamps do not reach. The handrail is warm at the top, and colder with every step.
